dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Sergeant Cookie was surrendered to the care center as a stray, and we have no history on her behavior in a home environment. She is reported to have bitten her finder after becoming overly aroused when being leashed and walked to the car, jumping up and grabbing at the leash and their clothes, before redirecting onto their leg, a bite and release that broke skin. Sergeant Cookie was also quick to jump up and grab the leash during her handling assessment. During her time at the care center, she has show social and playful behavior with handlers, but due to her low threshold for arousal we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Sergeant Cookie
